records.now: THE SOUL-BEAST RULE (recorded in the kit as CANON_LEDGER SB-11 and the author-law block of NO_MISTAKE_LIVE_RULES): this world has SOUL BEASTS, not ordinary animals. Every creature of the serial is a soul beast of a kind, with a year-tier; even the commonest thing of the world is a soul beast - blue silver grass, the low ground-cover of every country (named in ch1). The men's kept hunting beasts are the SPIRIT HOUNDS (soul beasts of the hound kind, kept, on the human side AND the beast side; Gao Tie holds the lead's collar); the ravine's ruler is the BLACK-RAVINE SERPENT, always named in full. records.was: The ch11-12 parallel panels set the year-takers' ring plans on slots canon does not allow: the grey stag's purple ring spoken of as Old Qin's second ring (he is a Soul King whose slots are long filled), and the old bull's purple ring planned as Xiao An's first ring on a Soul Master's frame with the answer that the Tang Sect's frontier teams call it a future.
records.now: THE RING-SLOT LAW (kit: CANON_LEDGER ER-12, ER-11 rewritten, the s33 author-law block in NO_MISTAKE_LIVE_RULES, glossary entry): a soul master's Nth ring is taken at the Nth decade of rank - the first at ten, the second at twenty, the third at thirty; a filled slot is never re-taken. The canon standard is thin lights for thin slots and the deep thousand-year light at the third and beyond - the workspace's Soul Land 2 receipts read thin-thin-deep (the fourth-year proctor and Bei Bei: two yellow rings and one purple across three). A thousand-year SECOND ring is a pedigree anomaly, rare even in Soul Land 2 (receipt: Wang Dong of Shrek carries it, the marked exception); a thousand-year FIRST ring is a death, never a plan. No panel, mirror or chapter sets a deep light on a thin frame: the border's deep lights are market goods - the tables buy depth for frames that have grown into it. Both panels rewritten (ch11: 'A thousand-year light... they buy depth for frames that have grown into it'); ch12: Old Qin's law speech, Xiao An's thin white first ring carried with her second light to come); mirrors swept; re-gated (ch11 2,896 words / 19 dialogue lines; ch12 3,292 / 27; project sweep PASS); kit commit 9e5c6dd.
